{{Top|leg}}
'''Charubah steel''' was a type of [[Steel/Legends|steel]] used by the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]]. It was used in the construction of the ''[[Star Home]]'', the flagship of the [[Hapan]] [[Queen Mother]]s.<ref name="hapan">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040506hapesmain|text=Hapes: Ladies First|int=Hapes: Ladies First}}</ref>
